threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can always spot newcomers by how they still wait for the bus at the stop instead of just strolling to the next stop like everyone else.
Caught a guy on the 35 bus singing to his reflection in the window—must’ve been deep in thought about something. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a family setting up a picnic in the middle of Weserstraße, oblivious to the traffic around. That’s when I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it's summer when the canal swimming areas turn into pop-up beach bars—BVG strike? They just set up a few extra loungers instead.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that avoiding the BART Civic Center during rush hour is a survival skill—nothing like a train brake failure to ruin your day.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo on the 31 Balboa, sipping from a thermos. Just another Saturday wedding after-party rolling through the city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's all about the parks and plazas, but they miss the hidden bars down the side streets where locals gather after dark.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking photos of the street signs, marveling at the tiny local bakeries like they’re treasures.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Overground is a ‘train’ instead of just a fancy Tube line. Locals know it's really just an extension of the bus route.
Caught the N35 last night; the driver was belting out old reggae tracks. Half the bus was singing along like a mobile concert, proper vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted the old lady at the bakery, arguing with the owner over the last pretzel. It felt like a scene straight outta a classic film, so local.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can grab a late-night döner after a techno club and find a spontaneous poetry slam happening by the canal. Only in Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their disdain for the BART delays—complaining about them is like our city sport. A working transplant just shrugs it off.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 49 bus calmly eating a bowl of cereal. Only in the Tenderloin do you get such breakfast multitasking on your morning commute.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars close at 2 AM. The locals know the best spots keep the party going till dawn, hidden away from the tourist traps.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still expect the metro to run on time. Locals know to plan around delays like they're part of the city's charm.
